svg.text: GUTENBERG TWO-PART ADJUSTABLE HAND MOLD (HANDGIEßINSTRUMENT c. 1450)
SLIDING L-FRAME KINEMATICS · HYDRODYNAMIC FOUNDER'S JERK (LE COUP DE MAIN) · ANTIMONY SOLIDIFICATION EXPANSION

g.text: SECTION 1: THE TWO-PART SLIDING L-FRAME KINEMATICS
INTERLOCKING L-SHAPED STEEL HALVES PERMITTING CONTINUOUS SET-WIDTH ADJUSTMENT
SECTION 2: HYDRODYNAMICS OF THE FOUNDER'S JERK (LE COUP DE MAIN)
OVERCOMING CAPILLARY SURFACE TENSION THROUGH UPWARD INERTIAL ROTATION
Liquid Surface Tension: γ = 0.45 N/m (Molten Pb-Sb-Sn)
Without Jerk (1g): r_min ≈ 45 μm (Rounded blunted serifs)
Matrix Chill Rate: Copper diffusivity k_Cu = 390 W/(m·K)
Solidification time at face: t_freeze ≈ 180 ms
Freezes from matrix face upward into jet -> ZERO cavitation voids
RHOMBOHEDRAL LATTICE EXPANSION PREVENTING THERMAL SHRINKAGE VOIDS
GUTENBERG ALLOY (78% Pb, 17% Sb, 5% Sn): +0.2% EXPANSION
WHY ANTIMONY (Sb) IS THE MASTER ELEMENT OF PRINTING:
1. Anomalous Freezing Expansion: Antimony crystallizes into an open rhombohedral lattice, expanding +3.0% by volume.
2. Zero Thermal Slack: Expansion presses cooling metal against matrix boundaries with 42 MPa internal stress.
3. Low Eutectic Melting Point: Drops casting temperature to 240°C, extending copper matrix life to 50,000+ casts.
SECTION 4: THE 7-STEP KINEMATIC FOUNDING CYCLE (2.8 SECONDS PER PIECE)
RENAISSANCE REPETITIVE MASS PRODUCTION (2,500 TO 4,000 PIECES / DAY / CASTER)
THE COMPLETED TYPE SORT (PIÈCE DE CARACTÈRE):

svg.text: DESIGN MINDS · DISCIPLINE: MECHANICAL TYPEFOUNDING KINEMATICS & TERNARY ALLOY THERMODYNAMICS · GEMINI NOON MIND
